title: Love God and Love Others Sort
purpose: Help children see the relational shape of God's instructions.
body_markdown:
# Love God and Love Others Sort

## Headings

- Love God
- Love Others
- Both

## Cards

- Worship God alone
- Use God's name with honour
- Tell the truth
- Respect life
- Keep promises
- Respect what belongs to others

## Safety card

If a person asks for harm, unsafe secrecy, or wrongdoing, tell a safe adult.
